nodes.question: How many environmental variables were utilized in predicting the potential distribution of Illicium griffithii?

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Desertification mitigation|Indigenous plant species use_qna_001
nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What is the definition of weeds according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Weeds are defined as plants that grow without cultivation on anthropogenically-modified land.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Desertification mitigation|Indigenous plant species use_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How many species were identified in the comprehensive checklist of useful plants in Uganda?
nodes.answer: The checklist identified 1,37 species with known human uses.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Desertification mitigation|Indigenous plant species use_qna_003
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What percentage of assessed threatened plant species has a known use according to the IUCN Red List?
nodes.answer: 21% of the assessed threatened plant species have a known use.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Desertification mitigation|Indigenous plant species use_qna_004
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How many native vascular plants have been recorded in Uganda?
nodes.answer: At least 4816 native vascular plants have been recorded in Uganda.

nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What dominant vegetation species were discovered in IREM according to the research?
nodes.answer: The dominant vegetation species in IREM are Dicranopteris pedata and Pinus massoniana.

nodes.answer: The plant species collected was Dicranopteris pedata.
